crossRefs.note: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
“The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
On the sixth day, Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad,

people.name: Deuel
people.line: Father of Eliasaph, leader of the tribe of Gad

people.name: Eliasaph
people.line: Son of Deuel, leader of the tribe of Gad

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

translations.web: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
translations.bsb: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
translations.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
translations.asv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
